title: Jagged, sick-day mustardy Kenyan Lasagne Skillet
description: A dense, comfort food-inspired dish featuring lasagne sheets, mustardy flavors, and a unique take on traditional Kenyan cuisine. Cook this in a cast-iron skillet for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use high heat cooking oil if available

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: or ground turkey, chicken, or beans for a vegetarian option

instructions: Heat oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the canned tomatoes and stir to combine with the meat and onion mixture.
Add the mustard, parsley, oregano, and garlic powder, and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the lasagne sheets to the skillet, slightly overlapping them to cover the bottom.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sheets start to soften.
Add salt and black pepper to taste, then transfer the skillet to the oven.
Bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and top with crumbled feta cheese, if using.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F.
